claimChanges.claimText: ChatGPT-4o via Campus-AI is listed for TU Dortmund University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: self hosted system.
Campus-AI is listed for TU Dortmund University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: self hosted system.
Academic Cloud ChatAI is listed for TU Dortmund University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutional ai service.
TU Dortmund's ChatGPT handout frames AI tools as increasingly everyday aids in university life and says universities should advance and critically accompany technical developments.
TU Dortmund's ChatGPT handout warns against using AI tools to check examination work and says uploading student names or matriculation numbers would implicate GDPR requirements.
TU Dortmund maintains a public Digitale Lehre page that provides a first orientation aid and further information about ChatGPT for staff and students.
TU Dortmund's ChatGPT handout states that existing declarations of independent work can be supplemented by subject-specific statements on whether and under what conditions AI tools may be used.
TU Dortmund's digitalization strategy includes AI as a dedicated action field and lists integration of AI tools into study, teaching, and assessment practice as a goal.
TU Dortmund announced that students and employees can use ChatGPT-4o through Campus-KI free of charge and anonymously, with access through SSO.
